purpose: Redo the v3 135M M=1 SNOO-style comparison with independently tuned, interior eta optima. All three v3 ARM S pooled curves selected their lowest registered eta, so the v3 best-grid comparison did not identify tuned optima.
prospective_scope: All v5 endpoint losses and all G5 calculations are unavailable at registration. The v3 ARM S readout is disclosed and used only to center the prospective v5 ladders.

v3_disclosure.edge_defect: Every condition's five-seed mean loss was lowest at eta index 0, the lower grid edge.
v3_disclosure.use_limitation: The v3 differences are not pooled with v5 and do not enter G5. They disclose the defect and select the v5 ladder centers only.

v4_drain_gate.evidence_rule: The sum of evidence.json files below the two node-local /root/yeto-results-v4 roots must equal 48.
v4_drain_gate.process_rule: pgrep -c -f 'run_slot_v[4]' must be zero independently on h200-n1 and h200-n2.
v4_drain_gate.why_sum_is_48: The v4 manifest assigns disjoint cells to node-local result filesystems; the registered stage has 48 cells total, not 48 per node.
v4_drain_gate.launch_authority_requirement: scripts/authorize_v5_launch.py must record both node counts, their sum of 48, and both zero process counts before creating authority.

a.name: plain_adamw
a.outer_optimizer: Nesterov implementation with mu=0, which is outer SGD
a.interpretation: At M=1 and eta=1 this applies each 512-step AdamW delta exactly; the surrounding mu0 eta curve tunes the baseline fairly.

b.name: snoo_style_outer_nesterov
b.interpretation: SNOO-style outer Nesterov on top of the single-worker AdamW trajectory.

c.name: code_true_eta_matched_control
c.outer_optimizer: Nesterov implementation with mu=0, which is outer SGD
c.interpretation: Condition-b eta mapped point-for-point to mu0 by the finite-T code-true applied-step law.

design.cell_identity: 3 conditions x 6 etas x 5 seeds = 90 cells
design.evaluation: The same frozen 1,024-row development evaluation is used for every cell.
design.execution: strict quorum, barrier synchronization, version-matched anchor, fixed 512-step windows, zero injected delay/jitter, rho telemetry, no outer bias correction

eta_design.even_grid_center_rule: The disclosed v3 best cell is the geometric midpoint in log2 eta between indices 2 and 3. Endpoints are 2.5 sqrt(2)-steps below and above that center.
eta_design.no_recenter_rule: No v5 ladder may be extended, narrowed, shifted, or otherwise changed after any v5 endpoint outcome exists.

code_true_match_law.implementation_meaning: The syncer applies Nesterov as g + mu*v after v <- mu*v + g; over five same-direction commits the cumulative mu.9 multiplier relative to mu0 is the finite geometric sum 1+mu+...+mu^4.

c.pairing: Every c eta is exactly the corresponding b eta multiplied by 4.0951 in the frozen Python float construction.

materialized_inputs.pre_outcome_materialization_disclosure: The five seed-shuffled no-wrap input bundles were materialized on both nodes before registration, using prepare_outer_mup_v3.py's deterministic algorithm with a v5-only output root and a v5 seed allowlist. No GPU work or v5 endpoint evaluation occurred.

frozen_analysis.curve_model: For each condition, fit loss = A*x^2+B*x+C by ordinary least squares to the six five-seed mean losses, where x=log2(eta).
frozen_analysis.interior_rule: A>0 and the fitted vertex -B/(2A) is strictly inside the numeric six-point log2 grid, with a 1e-12 coordinate tolerance. Boundary, outside, or nonpositive-curvature fits are UNBRACKETED.
frozen_analysis.tuned_loss: Evaluate the fitted quadratic at its interior vertex.
primary_estimands: fitted tuned loss(b) - fitted tuned loss(a)
fitted tuned loss(c) - fitted tuned loss(a)

bootstrap.pairing: Each replicate draws five indices with replacement from the five seeds and uses that same draw for every eta and all three conditions.
bootstrap.invalid_draw: A draw is invalid if any of its three fitted vertices is not interior.

evaluable_requirements: all 90 registered cells have COMPLETED hash-bound evidence
the pooled fitted optimum for each of a, b, and c is INTERIOR
at least 9500 of 10000 paired bootstrap refits are valid

closed_scientific_verdicts.SNOO_HELPS: the 95% paired-bootstrap CI for b-a has high endpoint < 0
closed_scientific_verdicts.SNOO_NULL: the 95% paired-bootstrap CI for b-a contains 0
closed_scientific_verdicts.SNOO_HURTS: the 95% paired-bootstrap CI for b-a has low endpoint > 0

gate_G5.not_evaluable_handling: If an evaluability requirement fails, status is NOT_EVALUABLE and no scientific verdict outside the closed three-value vocabulary is assigned.
gate_G5.condition_c_role: c-a is a co-reported primary estimand diagnosing the code-true eta-matched mu0 control; the SNOO verdict itself is determined by b-a.
gate_G5.note_line: G5 VERDICT: <SNOO_HELPS|SNOO_NULL|SNOO_HURTS> b-a=<signed point> [<signed low>,<signed high>] c-a=<signed point> [<signed low>,<signed high>]

frozen_analyzer.freeze_event: This raw file hash is recorded in both preregistration artifacts before git commit, push, and any v5 launch.

launch_machinery.execution_commit_rule: Both nodes execute at the pushed registration commit with clean worktrees.
launch_machinery.randomization: Global RNG seed 20260726 shuffle followed by round-robin assignment over interleaved h200-n1/h200-n2 GPU slots; 45 cells per node.

retry_contract.unit: all six etas for one condition-by-seed curve
retry_contract.forbidden: No retry for finite unfavorable loss, an edge optimum, scientific divergence, or any outcome-dependent reason. Attempt 2 replaces attempt 1 for every cell in an authorized retry group.

wall_clock.start_event: immutable v5 launch authority creation immediately before slot launch
wall_clock.stop_rule: At the deadline, controllers terminate only their recorded scientific process groups and seal remaining registered cells as NOT_RUN_WALL_CEILING.

storage.prior_result_rule: Never modify, move, delete, or reuse a prior result root.

operational_rails.process_control: Normal control targets recorded process groups. No wildcard pkill; if a name match is unavoidable, use a bracketed pattern such as run_slot_v[5].
operational_rails.git: Registration commit and push originate from the Mac clone. Nodes only fast-forward pull after v4 has fully drained.
operational_rails.prior_results: Read-only use of v3/v4 evidence; v5 writes only to new v5 roots.
